scripts.build:mcp: wrangler deploy --dry-run -c workers/mcp/wrangler.jsonc --outdir "$PWD/dist/mcp-current" --define BUILD_ID:'"current"' && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c workers/mcp/wrangler.jsonc --outdir "$PWD/dist/mcp-previous" --define BUILD_ID:'"previous"'
scripts.test:compat: npm run build:mcp && MCP_PREBUILT_DIR=dist/mcp-previous EXPECT_MCP_BUILD=previous vitest run
scripts.predev: wrangler d1 migrations apply packserver --local --persist-to .wrangler/state-dev -c workers/web/wrangler.jsonc
